note: First ARCH arm. Muse Glimmer's LLLG layout (3 sliding : 1 global) with a REAL 1024 sliding window, RoPE still on every layer. Isolates the windowing effect from NoPE, which e06 will add on top. Note the baseline e04 has interleaved_local_attention=true with window 256 but that is INERT (Finding A: no flash-attn-2 in this env), so e04 is effectively full attention on all 24 layers -- this is the first arm where any window actually masks. Expect CE to WORSEN slightly (18 of 24 layers lose half their context at block 2048); the question is how much, and whether the attention FLOP saving shows up.
